Messages.Author: Claus Staal
Messages.Body:
Comments/Improvements will be appreciated :)

Deck Name: Serpents
Created By: Claus Staal
Description: Utilizing the ability of "Summon the Serpent", being able
to search for any vampire with serpentis, not just setites, I found some
good use for both Synesios and Angra Mainyu, without having to include
multiple copies of each in the crypt. This deck relies on speed and
should keep up forward pressure at all times (as should any Setite deck)
- even if this means sacrificing a few minions from time to time. My
main problem with this deck really is pool gain ... I tried a few
Tributes, but my vamps never seemed to have blood enough (and the last
thing I want is for all of my vampires to hunt). I惴 not really sure
about the Voter Caps., but find them nonetheless of quite good use for
the odd deal done using Free States Rant, Voter Captivating and then
blast away using the KRC愀 (with the cryptic Rider). I扉e actually
almost never had serious problems getting my votes to pass, even with
only 2 inherent votes at my disposal (Synesios) and due to this fact had
Nehsi and Amisa removed from the crypt quite recently (replacing them
with an additional 2 Aabbt Kindreds). As with most weenie decks it will
loose power when reaching the midgame, but then again I don愒 really
seem to be able to find a way around that anyway.

As for bleed defence I removed everything from the deck ... previously
the deck had 4 Banner of Neutrality, 4 Ecstasy and 4 Wakes, but I never
really seemed to get use of them - so they were skipped all the same....

Crypt: (12 cards, Min: 9, Max: 26, Avg: 4,25)
---------------------------------------------
3 Aabbt Kindred for pre ser 4, Followers of Set
1 Sir Marriot D'Urban aus obf PRE ser 5, Followers of Set

votes

I actually made my own version of a "Free Snakes Rant" deck last
night. I'm sure it sucks, but I learned a bit from trying to piece it
together. I have neither Synesious nor Angra, so I used Aziz, Bajazet
and Melek (crappy, I'll probably put in Hesha instead) along with the
Settite vampires who have votes. All vampires have Presence and
Obfuscate. Most have Serpentis and the Assamites have Quietus. Also
threw in one Sutekh for good measure (I like big vampires).

> This deck relies on speed and
> should keep up forward pressure at all times (as should any Setite deck)

If you took out much of your bleeding, do you still have a lot of
forward pressure? There are 8 KRCs and a few bleeds left, but that
doesn't seem to be enough (for my taste at least).

> - even if this means sacrificing a few minions from time to time. My
> main problem with this deck really is pool gain

More Enchant Kindred! More Voter Captivation! More Minion Taps! Bigger
Vampires!

> I惴 not really sure
> about the Voter Caps., but find them nonetheless of quite good use for
> the odd deal done using Free States Rant, Voter Captivating and then
> blast away using the KRC愀 (with the cryptic Rider).

I was wondering where your Charming Lobbies are. It's a built-in
Cryptic Rider that doesn't cost blood, plus vampires with PRE get an
inferior Oration for free.

> I扉e actually
> almost never had serious problems getting my votes to pass, even with
> only 2 inherent votes at my disposal (Synesios) and due to this fact had
> Nehsi and Amisa removed from the crypt quite recently (replacing them
> with an additional 2 Aabbt Kindreds).

Definite metagame consideration here. That'd never fly in my area
except in the odd permutation of players.

> As with most weenie decks it will
> loose power when reaching the midgame, but then again I don愒 really
> seem to be able to find a way around that anyway.

Bigger vampires will help you in the midgame. I'm also unsure why you
wanted Angra so badly in your crypt. She's nice and all, but her
special doesn't make up for her Infernal-ness in this deck IMO. I
won't argue with Synesios.

> Crypt: (12 cards, Min: 9, Max: 26, Avg: 4,25)
> ---------------------------------------------
> 3 Aabbt Kindred for pre ser 4, Followers of Set
> 1 Sir Marriot D'Urban aus obf PRE ser 5, Followers of Set

> 1 Celine Chevalier obf ser 3, Followers of Set
> 1 Julius qui ser 1, Caitiff
> 1 Count Ormonde dom OBF pre ser 5, Followers of Set

Other vampires to consider (even though you pulled Amisa, I'd
reconsider):
Hesha (obf pre SER, super hunter/blood gainer)
Qufur (OBF PRE SER at 7 cap)
Amisa (OBF pre SER, 2 votes)
Kephamos (obf pre SER, 2 votes)
I also like 2 Count Ormonde and 2 Sir Marriot in place of some
weenies. If you add bigger vampires, you can probably cut back on the
number of discipline masters.

> Library: (90 cards)
> -------------------
> Master (16 cards)
> 2 Blood Doll
> 2 Creepshow Casino
> 1 Dreams of the Sphinx
> 1 Fear of Mekhet
> 1 Giant's Blood

I wouldn't include this one unless you have a larger crypt.

> 1 Khobar Towers, Al-Khubar
> 1 Minion Tap
> 2 Obfuscate
> 1 Opium Den

2 of these definitely!

> 2 Presence
> 1 Tabriz Assembly
> 1 Temple Hunting Ground

> Action (18 cards)
> 2 Clotho's Gift
> 1 Derange
> 4 Enchant Kindred
> 2 Form of Corruption
> 3 Social Charm
> 6 Summon the Serpent

Add a handful of Charming Lobbies. Synesios will appreciate it. Take
out Cryptic Riders for them. If you go with larger vamps, replace
Social Charm with Legal Manipulations, and definitely add more of the
"gain 1 pool" Presence bleeds in any case. Don't forget Temptation!
With all those FSRs, you're bound to get people in awkward situations.

> Action Modifier (32 cards)
> 7 Bewitching Oration
> 6 Cloak the Gathering
> 6 Cryptic Rider
> 2 Domain of Evernight
> 5 Forgotten Labyrinth
> 6 Voter Captivation

Superior Presence is key in vote decks so you can pull blood to your
pool with Voter Caps. Your crypt was lacking in that regard aside from
Synesios, Angra and Marriott. 5 vampires should be enough to get 1
into your initial 4, but Angra just rubs me the wrong way with this
deck. You have very little combat defense so consider using Swallowed
by the Night (especially if you put bigger OBF vamps in).

> Political Action (18 cards)
> 2 Banishment
> 8 Free States Rant
> 8 Kine Resources Contested
>
> Combat (6 cards)
> 6 Majesty

My deck went a bit further with the blood deprivation instead of
working the Synesios angle. I have 4 Allies including 2x Amam the
Devourer and 2x Ghouls of Plaza Moreria. I also put in one The
Summoning to get them more reliably. My idea there is to keep them
down with the Ghouls, FSRs, Foul Blood and Thrones Crumble(!), then
have the Devourers send them to torpor. While the vampires are hunting
and tapped via the Crumbles (lots of ppl play with titled vamps here
and the little ones are easily set into a permanent hunt mode with 1
or 2 FSRs). Temptation is also great for this.

Good luck with your deck!

Jeff

Totally corner case, and unless you see Justicars and Inner Circle

another blood doll. Or perhaps a Barrens for cycling capability or a
storage annex.

> 1 Giant's Blood

Why not a sudden reversal? I know you're low on blood a lot... but
consider them, as synesios has that cute special. :) perhaps axe a
skill card or two for them?

> 1 Khobar Towers, Al-Khubar
> 1 Minion Tap

Costly in blood, that's where all of your vampires bloods are goin'.
Its the focus of your deck, so I can't touch it, but is having one of
those other vampires all that important to you, with only less than 5
special cards for those two special vampires (the baalie and trujah).

> Action Modifier (32 cards)
> 7 Bewitching Oration
> 6 Cloak the Gathering
> 6 Cryptic Rider
> 2 Domain of Evernight

You can always increase this (swap 2 cloaks for 2 more) as you don't
need Synesios to cycle this card.

> 5 Forgotten Labyrinth
> 6 Voter Captivation
>
> Political Action (18 cards)
> 2 Banishment
> 8 Free States Rant

And just what are you planning on doing with these FSR anyhow? Drain
blood off others, make them hunt, drain blood and then steal? You've
got 2 Form of Corruption... Your other strategy is to call the vote,
pass it by setting it up for others and then Cryptic RIding a KRC...

> 8 Kine Resources Contested

Maybe swap 2 for conserv. agg.

> Combat (6 cards)
> 6 Majesty

Hmmm... you're gonna' get ripped up by combat decks... Unless you FSR
them or Banish them... then you're going (probably) not at your prey,
slowing you down...

I have a deck very similar to this and I hope to be play testing it
and posting it soon. I use enticements and sargon instead. Clotho's
gift for getting to good vampires, temptations to give sargon actions
w/o paying the pool, 4 FoC for stealing with my few FSR and some
conflagarations (because Danny Larkshill and Synesios can use them in
the outferior too, if I wanted).

Look for it at a later time.

Good luck with blending Bloodlines with other clans (like we're
supposedly supposed to do!).

~SV

I agreed with nothing until you mentioned legal manipulations...
before then you're contradicting yourself.

Charming Lobbies: Rquires Two actios this turn. One for the charming
lobby, and another to call that next vote. Realistically though...

Aabbt Kindred calls Charming Lobbied FSR or KRC: It gets voted down
hard core, even with you allocating lots of points somewhere else
other than at your prey. So what else do you need? The edge...

So REALLY charming lobby needs 3 actions in a deck... 1 to bleed to
get the egde, one to call teh FSR (edge is worth another vote, its
your safest bet) and THEN another action to call the KRC or FSR #2.

The larger the vampires you have the less likely you're to pull off
these multiple actions because you have less vampires on the table...
UNless you've got half of them tempted, and they're pulling off
multiple actions themselves. :)

Hence my thoughts are to stick with the Cryptice Riders, as people
won't know to vote your referendum down instantly, like they would
with CL and there's no quarentee of getting my vote after the CL, as
it might get blocked and someone else gets my free CL referendum
passed.

Well, it started with me just looking for all the possible Independent
vampires with Pre/Obf as disciplines so I could push through FSRs
better, and use bigger vampires to get some Voter Captivations in.
There are a handful of Assamites with Pre/Obf--Melek, Husamettin,
Aziz, Bajazet and Aziz (who also has ser). So, I figured I'd add a
couple of them into my crypt (2x Aziz, 2x Bajazet, 1x Melek who will
probably become Hesha).

Since that gave me 5 Assamites with QUI/OBF, I figured why not include
a couple of Foul Bloods so when vampires are inevitably hunting, I can
send a couple to torpor. Further, I added in 2x Ghouls of Plaza
Moreria to assist in keeping the blood supply low. I also tossed in a
couple of Scorpion's Touch for combat cards (with 5 Assamites, I can
expect to get 1 reliably).

No errata (at least not on that point, at any rate).
The text on the 1994 Jyhad-backed cards did not restrict the auto-pass
to your own votes, nor to the current turn.

1994 Jyhad card text:
Call a vote. If it passes, then the next vote passes automatically.
Superior: As above, and gain two votes.

The only "errata" has been a ruling on the above (which amounts to
errata on the 1995 VTES-backed text) that the first vote can be
any referendum you could normally call and is called as part of the
resolution of the CL action.
